📖 About GH3-Sync & Master Feature Guide

🎸 Why GH3-Sync was Created

In modern BetterGH3, players can matchmake online globally even if their song libraries differ. However, to actually play a custom song together in a lobby without crashing or desyncing, both players must have the identical audio files (.fsb.xen) and note highway packages (_song.pak.xen) installed on their hard drives. GH3-Sync solves this completely by establishing high-speed, secure P2P synchronization and automated song compilation between players with zero manual copying.

⚡ 1. Automatic Trusted Friend IP Sharing & Friends Network

GH3-Sync features a dual-tier friend security model designed for maximum privacy and effortless connectivity:

  • Automatic IP Sharing (Trusted Friends): When you click "Allow Trusted" on a friend, an encrypted Trust Token is generated for them. Their connection IP address is automatically discovered and shared in real time via LAN UDP discovery beacons (port 7374) and the Central Admin Hub. You never have to manually enter their IP or ask for a session PIN! In the P2P Sync tab, selecting their name from the dropdown connects you instantly.
  • IP Privacy & Protection (Regular Friends): For standard (untrusted) friends, automatic IP resolution is strictly blocked for security and privacy. Regular friends must exchange invite links or IP addresses manually and use a session PIN. This ensures nobody can discover your computer's IP address without your explicit permission.
  • Permanent Friend Codes: Every player receives a permanent 16-character alphanumeric Friend Code (e.g. GH3-6475-71AF) that never changes. Friend requests are added strictly via this code, preventing duplicate usernames, spamming, and spoofing.
  • 1-Click Revocation: You can click "Revoke Trust" or "Unfriend" at any time to immediately destroy their access token and permanently cut off automatic IP sharing.

🎶 2. ONOGAMI Song Creator (Rhythmic Auto-Charting & MIDI)

The built-in ONOGAMI Song Creator allows anyone to produce fully playable, authentic Guitar Hero III custom tracks in seconds:

  • Method 1: Rhythmic Beat & BPM Engine: Simply enter the Song Title, Artist, and BPM (tempo), then upload your audio track (MP3, OGG, or WAV). The ONOGAMI engine automatically charts authentic rhythm patterns, note highways, sustained notes, and star power phrases across all 4 difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert.
  • Method 2: Custom MIDI Chart Upload: If you already charted note highways in Moonscraper, Reaper, or EOF, simply upload your .mid or .chart file alongside the audio file.
  • Game-Ready Output: Compiles complete .chart, .mid, .fsb.xen multi-channel audio, .pak.xen highway files, and Honeycomb .ghproj project files.
  • ONOGAMI Engine Fingerprinting: Every created song is embedded with an ONOGAMI metadata signature and cryptographic audio hash, instantly visible in the "Created by Me (ONOGAMI)" collection.

🔗 3. P2P Song Synchronization & Setlist Sync

Synchronize custom songs with your online opponents and friends before launching into a match:

  • Select & Connect: Choose a Trusted Friend from the dropdown (IP resolves automatically) or paste a peer's invite URL.
  • Manifest Inspection: GH3-Sync compares the peer's installed songs against your local library and highlights tracks you are missing.
  • Selective or Batch Sync: Check the songs you wish to install, or click "Select All", then press "Sync Selected Songs". Songs are downloaded and installed directly into your game folder in seconds.
  • Direct Peer File Downloads (Beta 2): You can now click "⬇️ Download .gh3song" on any song (both already-synced tracks and missing tracks) to download the standalone song package directly to your computer.

🛡️ 4. Duplicate Song Prevention & Fingerprint Matching

Never worry about cluttered menus, overwriting existing songs, or downloading duplicate files:

  • When comparing songs with a peer or importing archive files, GH3-Sync analyzes song IDs, title/artist strings, and ONOGAMI engine fingerprints.
  • If a track is already installed in your game, GH3-Sync automatically unchecks it during sync and tags it with an [Installed] warning badge so duplicates are never downloaded or overwritten.

💾 5. Career Save Protection & 1-Click Restoration

In Guitar Hero III, recompiling custom songs can cause the vanilla game engine to reset career star ratings and high scores:

  • Automated Snapshots: GH3-Sync automatically creates safety backups of your career save files (s000.d and toc.dat) before every sync, import, or song installation.
  • 1-Click Restoration: If your career stars or score ever reset, visit the Career Saves tab and click "Restore Latest Career Save". Your high scores, star ratings, and unlocked items will be restored immediately while keeping all newly installed custom songs!

📁 6. Universal Game Directory & BetterGH3 Compatibility

GH3-Sync adapts to any user's PC setup:

  • Custom Path Selection: Click "Game Config" in the top navigation bar to set your Guitar Hero III installation directory (e.g. G:\Home\Games\Guitar Hero III or standard Program Files).
  • Compatibility Engine: Checks for the presence of GH3.exe, bettergh3.asi, DATA/SONGS, and DATA/MUSIC, providing real-time compatibility badges.
  • Direct Game Installation: When enabled, songs are placed straight into active game folders so you can jump into gameplay immediately.

📦 7. Song Archive Importer (.gh3, .gh3song, .gh3pack) & Pack Exporter

Easily manage, share, and backup custom song archives:

  • Import Songs: Drag and drop any .gh3, .gh3song, or .gh3pack file into the Import Songs tab to install it with one click.
  • Export Full Pack: On the My Customs tab, click "Export All as Pack" to package your entire custom song collection into a single portable .gh3pack zip file to share with friends or transfer to a new PC.

🖥️ 8. Real-Time In-Game Companion HUD & Diagnostic Logging

Stay informed during multiplayer gaming and troubleshooting:

  • In-Game HUD Overlay: When Guitar Hero III is active with the GH3 companion plugin, on-screen notifications display: [GH3-SYNC ACTIVE], [SYNCING: Song Name 45%], and [✓ SUCCESS: Song Installed].
  • Diagnostic Logger: Handshakes, network transfers, and compilation events are recorded in real time on the Security & Logs tab and persisted to gh3_sync.log for troubleshooting.

📊 9. Central Admin Panel & Live Feedback System

Comprehensive network health, telemetry, and developer support:

  • "⚠️ Not Working?" Instant Feedback: Encountered an issue or have a suggestion? Click the Not Working? button on any page to submit feedback with automatic diagnostic tags directly to the Admin Hub.
  • Standalone Admin Panel (GH3-Sync-Admin): Administrators can run GH3-Sync-Admin.exe on port 7575 to monitor live active users, track feature popularity on the usage leaderboard, review and filter feedback, and broadcast system-wide announcements to all active players.
